title: PAIOS Audit Record
description: A single append-only entry written at every lifecycle state transition. The sink accepts no updates and no deletes; a correction is a new record referencing the record it corrects.

from_state.description: Absent on the first record of a request.

detail.description: Transition-specific fields. Must not contain request or output content; the audit trail records that work occurred and under what authority, not what the work said.

corrects.description: record_id this entry corrects. Corrections are appended, never applied in place.
